title.why: The English overview (document-1.pdf, page 3) says 'the Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI) was established in Feb. 2024'. The record title 'Establishment of the Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI)' is a descriptive title for an institution with no formal instrument title; acceptable.

original_title.why: The cover of the Japanese deck (document-2.pdf page 1) reads 'AIセーフティ・インスティテュート（AISI）について'; the record gives the body's name without 'について' ('about'), which is correct for the name. The official page spells it 'AIセーフティ・インスティテュート (AISI)' with half-width brackets; the record follows the deck's full-width brackets.

issuing_body.why: official.html: '2024年2月14日にIPAに事務局を設置しました' and 'AISIはAI安全性の中心的機関としてIPAに設置され'; the deck (page 7) says it is a government-related body with the secretariat in IPA under METI and the Digital Agency.

date_published.why: official.html: '2024年2月14日にAIセーフティ・インスティテュートを発足させました' (launched on 14 February 2024).

status.why: The 1 July 2026 deck presents the body as operating, with the Executive Director shown as '[Current]'; nothing stored or found suggests closure.

legal_force.why: Unchanged; an institution set up under a Cabinet strategy, no binding rules.

language.why: Japanese page and deck plus J-AISI's English deck.

english_version.why: kind 'authentic': the English deck 20260708_AISI_en.pdf is published by J-AISI itself on aisi.go.jp. url matches the stored document-1.pdf (archive/JP-01/2026-10-11/document-1.pdf). It is an English edition of the overview, not of a legal text; 'authentic' is the right kind for an issuer's own English version.

notes.why: 21 Dec 2023 announcement and the Executive Director (official.html); 12 ministries and 5 organisations, IPA under METI and the Digital Agency (deck page 7); liaison council with the Cabinet Office as secretariat and Steering Committee chaired by the Executive Director (deck page 8). The second AI Basic Plan claim is supported by the stored English translation of that plan under JP-06 (archive/JP-06/2026-10-11/secondary.pdf.txt: 'Centered on AISI, establish and strengthen technical evaluation capabilities'; 'fundamentally strengthen the functions of AISI'). 'No specific statutory basis in the AI Promotion Act' is consistent with the full text of the Act stored under JP-04 (archive/_runs/2026-10-14-refresh-translation-fixes/JP-04/extra-d5f234a0a9/2026-10-14/official.html.txt), which never mentions AISI or a Safety Institute. These two statements are not in this extraction's own evidence; they were also in the existing record.

safety_topics.why: Unchanged: safety institute, evaluation & testing, international cooperation, all in the 'AISIの業務' section.

summary_claims.claim: Designated by the Integrated Innovation Strategy 2024 as Japan's central institution for AI safety
summary_claims.locator: official.html history: '「統合イノベーション戦略2024」（2024年6月4日閣議決定）に基づき、AISIはAI安全性の中心的機関としてIPAに設置され'. My translation: 'Based on the Integrated Innovation Strategy 2024 (Cabinet decision of 4 June 2024), AISI is established in IPA as the central institution for AI safety'. Deck page 4 and English deck page 4: 'designated as the central institution'.

summary_claims.claim: Studies safety-related standards, check tools, countermeasures against disinformation, and AI and cybersecurity; examines AI test environments
summary_claims.locator: official.html, AISIの業務 1: '安全性に係る標準、チェックツール、偽情報対策技術、AIとサイバーセキュリティに関する調査' (surveys on standards, check tools, disinformation countermeasure technologies, and AI and cybersecurity) and '上記に関するAIのテスト環境の検討' (examination of AI test environments for the above).

summary_claims.claim: Secretariat in IPA; cooperates with the UK and US counterparts
summary_claims.locator: official.html: '英国・米国等の同様の機関とも連携しつつ'; '事務局を設置' in IPA.

summary_claims.claim: Links industry, academia and national research institutes; supports government
summary_claims.locator: document-2.pdf page 5: '政府への支援' and '日本におけるAIセーフティのハブ ... 国研等の関係研究機関との連携'.

scope.note: Government AI safety institute; mandates of AI safety bodies are in scope with no note.

note: The updated summary and notes follow the stored Japanese page and the two July 2026 overview decks; every claim I traced was found. The Japanese terms are rendered literally (central institution, secretariat, Steering Committee chaired by the Executive Director). The English deck's 'Innovation Platform Agency' for IPA on two pages is a likely slip by the issuer; the record sensibly keeps 'Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan' as on the site footer. The two statements in the notes that rest on other records' stored files (second AI Basic Plan, AI Promotion Act) are supported there. No blind-sample disagreement for this record.
